label: SI-13(4)
title: Standby Component Installation and Notification

statement.prose: If system component failures are detected:

children.label: (a)
children.prose: Ensure that the standby components are successfully and transparently installed within {{ insert: param, si-13.04_odp.01 }} ; and

guidance: Automatic or manual transfer of components from standby to active mode can occur upon the detection of component failures.

params.label: time period
guidelines: time period for standby components to be installed is defined;

params.label: alarm
guidelines: alarm to be activated when system component failures are detected is defined (if selected);

params.label: action
guidelines: action to be taken when system component failures are detected is defined (if selected);
